summary.text: Gail Griffin, a Republican, represents District 19 in the Arizona House of Representatives and is not seeking re-election to it; she is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for the Arizona State Senate seat from District 19.

paragraphs.text: According to her legislative biography, Griffin previously served in the Arizona State Senate, is a real estate broker, and lives in Cochise County.
Ballotpedia lists her as an associate broker with Sierra Vista Realty since 1975 and as chair of the Cochise County Republican Committee from 2002 to 2006.
